description: Source code for GPIO driver for Nuvoton NPCX hardware in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, initialization, and interrupt handling functions.

methods.name: npcx_get_gpio_dev
methods.description: Returns the GPIO device for a given port.

methods.name: npcx_gpio_enable_io_pads
methods.description: Enables IO pads for a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: npcx_gpio_disable_io_pads
methods.description: Disables IO pads for a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_npcx_config
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags.

methods.name: gpio_npcx_pin_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_npcx_port_get_raw
methods.description: Gets raw GPIO port input value.

methods.name: gpio_npcx_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets raw GPIO port output value with mask.

methods.name: gpio_npcx_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets bits in GPIO port output.

methods.name: gpio_npcx_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears bits in GPIO port output.

methods.name: gpio_npcx_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles bits in GPIO port output.

methods.name: gpio_npcx_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt for a GPIO pin.
